name: sha256_preimage_short
description: Prove SHA256(preimage) == hash for a fixed 32-byte preimage. Both preimage and digest are split into two 128-bit halves so they fit in BN128 field elements; this matches Solidity's bytes32 layout

hashHigh.description: Most-significant 128 bits of the SHA256 digest

hashLow.description: Least-significant 128 bits of the SHA256 digest
